shots.p: two-faced men swearing loyalty with their hands raised
a man hiding behind a shield of false oaths
a man who believed then turned back, darkness in his eyes
tall handsome men like wooden logs propped against a wall
a man arrogantly turning his head away
a man turning away, deaf to advice
men whispering to cut off aid to the poor
men boasting of power in a city
a family busy with wealth and children, heedless
a man giving charity before the sun sets on his life
an old man's final breath, a candle going out
